title: UK ETS 2026 free-allocation stage-2 QA controls

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for installations: how to comply

facts.source_fact: The current free-allocation application process concerns the 2027 to 2030 allocation period.
facts.expected_handling: Bind all stage-2 records to the 2027-2030 allocation period.

facts.source_fact: The application for 2027 to 2030 free allocation is a two-stage process under the Free Allocation Regulation.
facts.expected_handling: Require stage provenance before eligibility conclusions.

facts.source_fact: Stage 1 ran from 1 April to 30 June 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve the stage-1 submission window.

facts.source_fact: Stage 1 required a baseline data report.
facts.expected_handling: Carry baseline-data-report provenance.

facts.source_fact: Stage 1 required a verification report.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat unverified baseline data as stage-1 complete.

facts.source_fact: Stage 1 required a monitoring methodology plan unless an approved plan already existed.
facts.expected_handling: Record whether the MMP requirement was newly satisfied or already approved.

facts.source_fact: Stage 2 ran from 1 April to 30 June 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the stage-2 submission window to application records.

facts.source_fact: Stage 2 requires the operator to notify the regulator if it wishes the application to proceed.
facts.expected_handling: Require an affirmative proceed status rather than assuming continuation.

facts.source_fact: Stage 2 can require resubmission of documents to reflect policy changes since 31 March 2025.
facts.expected_handling: Version documents against the post-31-March-2025 policy state.

facts.source_fact: An operator cannot complete stage 2 without having completed stage 1.
facts.expected_handling: Block stage-2-only eligibility claims.

facts.source_fact: Both stages must be completed to receive free allocation for 2027 to 2030.
facts.expected_handling: Require both-stage completion before eligible status.

facts.source_fact: Technical guidance for stage 2 was added to the UK ETS guidance collection on 5 May 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Attach the guidance version date to stage-2 interpretations.

facts.source_fact: UKETS12A FAR guidance was introduced to support completion of stage 2.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve guidance-document provenance in derived checks.

facts.source_fact: UKETS11 FAR guidance on installation-level allocation was revised alongside stage-2 guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Use the current allocation guidance version.

facts.source_fact: UKETS13 FAR monitoring and reporting guidance was revised alongside stage-2 guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Use the current monitoring-and-reporting guidance version.

facts.source_fact: Free allocation for 2027 to 2030 is calculated and approved in line with the Free Allocation Regulation.
facts.expected_handling: Keep the regulatory calculation basis with any allocation output.

facts.source_fact: The UK ETS Authority is to publish the 2027 to 2030 allocation table by the end of 2026.
facts.expected_handling: Do not infer final allocation-table inclusion before publication.

facts.source_fact: An installation included in the allocation table becomes subject to free-allocation conditions in its permit.
facts.expected_handling: Bind permit-condition status to confirmed table inclusion.

facts.source_fact: The allocation table may be updated periodically for allowance changes and new entrants.
facts.expected_handling: Treat allocation-table status as versioned rather than immutable.

facts.source_fact: Free allowances are normally allocated to the operator holding account by 28 February each year unless the regulator instructs withholding.
facts.expected_handling: Separate entitlement from actual registry allocation and withholding status.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve the cited rule without widening its scope.
Attach installation, permit and allocation-period scope.
Attach stage window and guidance version.
Carry FAR, BDR, verification and MMP provenance.
Do not convert installation allocation governance into parcel-level measured emissions.
